cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium & General Assembly 2027
cand.organizationName: OENOVITI INTERNATIONAL, Agroscope and UAS Changins
cand.excerpt: Strongest accessibility signal: participants book accommodation directly and may choose alternatives.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Named relationship contacts, not verified contracting buyers: Agathe Lairy, ISVV international-relations head and OENOVITI project-manager contact; Pierre-Louis Teissedre, professor and head/coordinator of OENOVITI; Isabel Baehler, Changins general-secretariat head, for local-host routing only. The OENOVITI Coordination Office explicitly handles event organization. No retrieved evidence assigns hotel, catering or transport contract authority to these individuals.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, Switzerland; theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing Environmental, Social and Human Challenges. Agroscope gives the activity range 08:30–18:00 and registration opening 1 December 2026 at 00:01. These are activity dates, not publication dates. This edition is future and within the requested horizon as of 16 November 2026. No 2028 edition announcement was located on the official events listing.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: the Nyon/La Côte location is territorially relevant to YOTEL Geneva Lake in Founex. Best plausible role is alternative participant accommodation, potentially combined with a separately requested small dinner/reception or workshop—not displacement of the Changins symposium. The supplied 237 guestrooms, six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre maximum make mid-size ancillary business plausible, but 2027 attendance and lodging take-up are unpublished, so capacity fit and any 20–120-room commercial target remain unvalidated. This is not downtown-Geneva megashow housing or a resort retreat requirement. Transfers to Changins and the B&B activity departure point would need an agreed solution; no YOTEL transport or booking arrangement is evidenced.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Changins, hosted by Changins | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie and Agroscope. Changins publishes its address as Route de Duillier 52, CH-1260 Nyon. Territory: Nyon/La Côte, Vaud, Switzerland—not Founex itself, Geneva city or Lausanne. Academic/research site, not a competing hotel. Public venue announcement is verified; signed venue contracts, individual rooms and allocation of each programme activity are not disclosed.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified annual series with changing destinations: online in 2022; Kyoto/Yamanashi-Kofu/Niigata, Japan in 2023; Asti, Italy in 2024; Vienna, Austria in 2025; Porto, Portugal in 2026; Nyon, Switzerland announced for 2027. Historical university hosts do not represent available hotel inventory. Annual recurrence does not establish another Swiss edition in 2028.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Participant-direct booking with an edition-specific recommended hotel: Hôtel B&B NYON, 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon—the only hotel named in the retrieved 2027 event instructions. OENOVITI states: “Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings” and “Activities will depart and return to this location.” Agroscope states: “Accommodations have to be booked directly by each participant at B&B hotel, Nyon. You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs.” Corporate code NOVITI27 identifies conference participants. This verifies an incumbent recommendation and logistics base, not an organizer-guaranteed room block, exclusive housing contract, open RFP or housing bureau. Rates, allotment, release date and rooms contracted are unpublished.
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI is an international academic/research/industry network, administered by an Executive Committee; its Bordeaux-based ISVV Coordination Office is the event-organization contact. ADERA manages network finances, collects membership fees and supports project management. Changins and Agroscope are the published 2027 hosts/co-organizers. Do not recast ADERA as a PCO, Changins as the event owner, or the recommended hotel as the buyer. A separate PCO/DMC or housing bureau is not identified in the reviewed edition material.
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B NYON has an edition-specific corporate code, organizer recommendation and activity departure/return advantage. Alternative accommodation is explicitly permitted, but there is no published evidence of sell-out, overflow, unmet room demand or an available block. Main event functions are assigned to Changins; no outsourced catering brief or unassigned dinner venue has been verified. Do not describe all lodging as committed elsewhere, or the absence of exclusivity as open hotel sourcing.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Agathe Lairy through the OENOVITI Coordination Office before registration opens on 1 December 2026; ask who manages 2027 lodging recommendations, transport and off-site meals. Offer an optional participant-booked YOTEL rate subject to availability and a workable transfer plan, without requesting displacement of B&B NYON. Ask whether an additional hotel can be circulated and whether any dinner, reception or small breakout remains unassigned. Use Isabel Baehler to identify the actual Changins local organizer and budget holder; use Pierre-Louis Teissedre for a senior introduction if needed. Establish attendance, overnight share, arrival/departure pattern and authorized purchaser before pricing a block or catering package.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the researched 2027 edition, alternative participant bookings are explicitly accessible in principle, despite the B&B recommendation. Organizer-led block access and permission to add another hotel to official communications are unconfirmed. Registration is scheduled to open 1 December 2026; outreach before then could test inclusion, but does not establish an open tender.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build relationships with the coordination office and the two Swiss hosts for ancillary 2027 business and any later Swiss-hosted workshops. The series rotates internationally; no repeat Nyon edition or 2028 Swiss dates are confirmed. Do not forecast recurring annual YOTEL room nights or assume a future conference relocation opportunity.
